What Verkflo does in banking operations

Back-office teams spend much of the day assembling cases: pulling the transaction, the credit file, the application form and the account history into one place before anyone can decide. That assembly is the part a Verkflo agent does. It follows the steps of your procedure, applies your policy rules as CEL conditions and writes a summary for the person who owns the decision.

Core banking, card processing and loan origination systems connect through Custom REST when they expose an API. The agent reads the data the case needs, and the rules in your procedure choose what happens next.

Who does what in banking operations

  • The procedure

    Your operations procedures set the evidence a dispute needs, the limits your credit policy gives analysts, the documents a loan file must hold and the checks before an account closes.

  • What the agent does

    • Gathers the cardholder claim and transaction data for a dispute

    • Compares a credit application with the credit file and flags differences

    • Checks a loan application against your document checklist

    • Lists holds, open items and alerts before an account closes

  • What your team decides

    • Dispute outcomes and any credit to the cardholder under your policy

    • Limit increases outside the limits your policy sets for analysts

    • Credit decisions on a completed file

    • Whether an account closes and what the customer is told

Banking operations procedures you can run today

Card, lending and account work, each with example runs.

  • +1↗ Chargebacks and disputesGather the cardholder's claim and the transaction data, map it to your scheme rules and queue the proposal for an analyst.
  • +1↗ Credit limit increase reviewRun the exposure and account checks in your policy and send anything outside it to a reviewer.
  • +1↗ Credit file checkCompare the application with the credit file, apply your flags and route differences to an underwriter.
  • +1↗ Loan application completenessCheck each application against your document and field checklist before an underwriter opens it.
  • +1↗ Account closure reviewCheck each closure request against your list of holds, open items and alerts before anyone closes the account.
  • +1↗ Complaints triageCategorize each complaint on arrival, apply your response timelines and route sensitive cases to a person.

Complaints and closures across teams

Two procedures cut across departments. Complaints triage reads each complaint as it arrives, tags it with your categories and routes the sensitive ones to a named handler. Account closure review checks holds and open alerts first, so a closure waits while an alert on the account is still open.

Fintechs running similar work with a smaller team can start from fintech operations automation. Financial crime casework is on compliance operations automation.

Controls your auditors will ask about

These controls apply to each agent you build. Sample data

    • Admin
    • Author
    • Reviewer
    • Auditor

    Role-based access

    Admin, Author, Reviewer and Auditor roles, scoped to each workspace.

    • 417c2e…
    • 42a91f… ← 7c2e
    • 4303d8… ← a91f

    Hash-chained audit log

    Each entry carries the hash of the one before it. Verifying the log recomputes the chain and flags entries that no longer match.

  • v1.1v1.2v1.3Published

    Versioned specs

    Each run records the exact version it followed; old versions stay readable.

  • * * * * * * * *vault/sumsub/key

    Secrets in a vault

    Steps point to a vault path, and the key stays in the vault.

    • Signed delivery✓ accepted
    • Unsigned delivery✕ rejected

    Signed webhook triggers

    Unsigned or stale deliveries are rejected before a run starts.

  • SandboxLive

    Sandbox before live

    New versions run on test data first. Going live is a separate step.

Banking operations questions

Can it connect to our core banking system?

If the system has an API, yes, through Custom REST. The credentials are stored as a vault reference, and each call is recorded against the run.

Does the agent approve credit or refund disputes?

Those decisions stay with your analysts and underwriters. The agent prepares the case, applies the limits in your policy and marks anything outside them for a person.

How do we roll out a change to a procedure?

Edit a draft, run the eval scenarios in the sandbox and publish when they pass. Earlier versions stay readable alongside the runs that used them.
